headline: Herro scores career-high 50, but 76ers hold off Bucks 132-129

top.headline: Herro scores career-high 50, but 76ers hold off Bucks 132-129
top.summary: Tyler Herro scored 50 points on 15-of-23 shooting with 11 rebounds, topping his previous career high of 41. His tying 3 at the end was reviewed and ruled to have left his hand after time expired. Philadelphia is 14-3, tied for the NBA's best record; Milwaukee has lost 16 of its first 17.

top.headline: Wembanyama posts 50 and 19 as Spurs roll Pelicans
top.summary: Victor Wembanyama had 50 points, 19 rebounds, 5 blocks and 4 steals in a 114-91 win, his second 50-point game this season. The Spurs have won two straight since their 12-game streak ended. New Orleans has lost nine of 10, and Zion Williamson was a late scratch with a left thigh contusion.

top.headline: Maple Leafs' winless streak hits nine
top.summary: Zach Werenski scored the winner with 3:28 left as Columbus won 4-3 in Toronto. The Maple Leafs are 0-8-1 in their last nine and 1-10-1 in their last 12.

leagues.name: NFL
leagues.summary: Week 11 Sunday: Daniel Jones on waivers until Monday; Murray out, Mayfield expected to play

stories.headline: Colts release Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson Sr. takes over
stories.summary: The 3-8 Colts released Daniel Jones on Friday, a week after benching him. He is on waivers until Monday afternoon, and a claiming team would owe the rest of his 2026 salary. No claim had been reported as of Saturday.

stories.headline: Vikings rule out Kyler Murray and Jordan Addison for Mexico City
stories.summary: Minnesota ruled out Murray (hamstring) and receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) for Sunday night's game against the 49ers in Mexico City. San Francisco listed QB Mac Jones as questionable with an illness.

stories.headline: Cardinals expected to start Josh Johnson at Kansas City
stories.summary: Arizona quarterback Carson Beck is out with a back injury, so Josh Johnson, 40, is expected to start against the Chiefs. Kansas City has ruled out running back Kenneth Walker III (groin) and guard Trey Smith.

stories.headline: Baker Mayfield expected to play at Detroit
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is expected to play Sunday against the Lions. Tom Pelissero reported the foot problem is a plantar fascia injury, and Mayfield will wear a special orthotic and new cleats.

stories.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua likely done for the season after knee surgery
stories.summary: Sean McVay said Nacua had MCL surgery and will be out "a couple months," which likely ends his season. He was already on injured reserve and serving a three-game league suspension.

His tying 3 at the end was reviewed and ruled to have left his hand after time expired. Philadelphia is 14-3, tied for the NBA's best record; Milwaukee has lost 16 of its first 17.

The Spurs have won two straight since their 12-game streak ended. New Orleans has lost nine of 10, and Zion Williamson was a late scratch with a left thigh contusion.

stories.headline: Yahoo: officials missed Embiid stepping out in final seconds
stories.summary: With Philadelphia up 130-129, Joel Embiid stepped on the baseline after an inbounds pass, Yahoo Sports reported, but no call was made and Milwaukee had no challenges left. Herro had to foul, and Embiid made both free throws.

stories.headline: Bridges buzzer-beater lifts Knicks past Blazers 97-96
stories.summary: Mikal Bridges hit a 25-foot step-back 3 at the buzzer after Portland came back from as many as 26 points down. Jalen Brunson scored 30 for New York, which has won four straight. Both teams are 10-6.

standouts.name: Tyler Herro
standouts.note: Career high, but his tying 3 came after the buzzer in a 132-129 loss.

standouts.name: Victor Wembanyama
standouts.note: His second 50-point game this season, in a 114-91 win over New Orleans.

standouts.name: Joel Embiid
standouts.note: His two late free throws sealed the win over Milwaukee.

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Leafs winless in nine; Scheifele sets Jets goals record; Blues beat Devils 9-6

stories.headline: Maple Leafs' winless streak hits nine
stories.summary: Zach Werenski scored the winner with 3:28 left as Columbus won 4-3 in Toronto. The Maple Leafs are 0-8-1 in their last nine and 1-10-1 in their last 12.

stories.headline: Scheifele becomes Jets/Thrashers franchise goals leader
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele's 380th goal passed Dale Hawerchuk for the most in franchise history. Vegas still won 5-4 in a shootout in Winnipeg, ending a four-game losing streak, after Ivan Barbashev tied it with 3:35 left.

stories.headline: Blues beat Devils 9-6; Hellebuyck pulled in first period
stories.summary: Jake Neighbours had five assists, tying a Blues franchise record, as St. Louis won its third straight. Devils goalie Connor Hellebuyck was pulled after allowing four goals on six shots.

stories.headline: Canucks end Wild's win streak; Kaprizov ties franchise point-streak mark
stories.summary: Marco Rossi scored twice, including the tying goal with 1:23 left, and Vancouver won 4-3 in a shootout to end Minnesota's five-game winning streak. Kirill Kaprizov stretched his point streak to 14 games, tying the Wild record. Vancouver's Elias Pettersson is day to day with an upper-body injury.

stories.headline: Hurricanes score five in second period, beat Oilers 7-4
stories.summary: Carolina beat Edmonton in a matchup of division leaders behind a five-goal second period. Andrei Svechnikov scored twice and Sebastian Aho had a goal and two assists.

standouts.name: Elias Lindholm
standouts.note: A career high in a 7-5 win over Washington, which has lost five straight.

standouts.name: Jake Neighbours
standouts.note: Tied the Blues' franchise record for assists in a game in a 9-6 win over New Jersey.

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.summary: Offseason · Mets extend A.J. Ewing; Angels sale expected to close in January

stories.headline: Mets agree to eight-year extension with A.J. Ewing
stories.summary: The Mets and A.J. Ewing agreed to an eight-year extension with a club option for a ninth season, SNY reported. The Athletic reported $95 million guaranteed.

stories.headline: Manfred: Angels sale to Stan Kroenke expected to close after New Year's
stories.summary: Rob Manfred said he expects Arte Moreno's sale of the Angels to close "just after the first of the year." Until then the Angels can't hire a full-time GM or president of baseball operations.

stories.headline: Report: Mets offered Tarik Skubal nine years, $400 million
stories.summary: MLB Network Radio's Jim Duquette reported the Mets offered Skubal a nine-year, $400 million deal. Skubal has reportedly met with five teams. Freddy Peralta and Michael King are expected to wait until he signs.
